playwrightTests: enforces per-user group and camera access with Paper-grounded controls
browserTests: defaults to everything and edits group and camera grants on the selected user
preserves selected cameras after a failed save and offers an explicit reload
disables writes when the capability disappears without losing the draft
constraints: Administrators manage grants on a named User credential and always retain unrestricted camera access.
New credentials and absent policies default to everything; explicit restrictions remain unchanged.
Selected access is the union of camera namespace groups and explicit camera IDs; an empty selection grants none.
Each group and camera list allows at most 128 IDs of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
Camera grants remain separate from grid audiences and never change canonical grid tiles.
Saves use credential revisions and close existing sessions; failures retain drafts.
All settings remain in config.toml with private strings in its companion secrets.toml.
notes: Supplementary Paper states are design and runtime-test evidence, not an approved pixel baseline. Desktop panels use 645px width, 18px padding and 44px rows; the mobile state uses 16px padding and 52px rows. Runtime icon actions and viewport containment are verified by browser tests. Historical unavailable-capability snapshots remain separate.
